  A) 1.5% of the amount for each 30-day month late, so ₹150 per month, charged in proportion to the days  B) One flat fee of ₹500, however late it is  C) ₹50 for every day late
  Your answer (a letter, or your own words) >
reply: Nothing is charged until an invoice is at least 30 days overdue. After that we charge 5% of the amount for each full 30 days late, with no pro-rating for part-months. So Priya's ₹10,000 at 45 days overdue is one full 30-day period, which is a ₹500 fee. At 60 days it would be ₹1,000.
